title: Tenure Share of the Comfort Club Reinstatement Fee
content:
Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements members with long, unbroken membership pay a reduced share of the reinstatement fee.

## Tenure share rule
- **Long-tenure share, 0.5:** an agreement that held at least **7** consecutive terms when it lapsed and has **no reinstatement fee anywhere on its dues ledger**.
- **Loyal share, 0.8:** an agreement that held at least the tier's loyalty term count of consecutive terms (**3** on every Comfort Club tier) but does not meet both long-tenure conditions.
- **Any other agreement:** no reduced share under this rule.

The term count is the consecutive term count the agreement held when it lapsed. "Anywhere on its dues ledger" covers every reinstatement fee charge ever posted on the agreement, in any term.

## Truth table

| Consecutive terms at lapse | Earlier reinstatement fee on the dues ledger | Tenure share |
|---|---|---|
| 7 or more | none | 0.5 |
| 7 or more | one or more | 0.8 |
| 3 to 6 | any | 0.8 |
| 1 or 2 | any | no reduced share |

## Examples (hypothetical lapse-adjusted fee of 25.00)
- 9 terms at lapse, never reinstated before: 25.00 multiplied by 0.5 gives 12.50.
- 9 terms at lapse, a reinstatement fee charged four years earlier: 25.00 multiplied by 0.8 gives 20.00.
- 2 terms at lapse: no reduced share.
